info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Replace Product Management By Param1-spec
info.description: This API allows authorized users to update the product design details for a specific banking product identified by a unique parameter. By providing the necessary data and the product's identifier, businesses can effectively manage and refine their product offerings. It is designed for use by banks and financial institutions aiming to synchronize product information across their platforms. Typical consumers include product managers and developers involved in maintaining the product catalog and optimizing user experience.

put.description: This endpoint allows you to update the design details of a specific product identified by PROD-700045. Ensure that all required fields are included in the request body for a successful update.

requestBody.description: The request body for updating the product design with the identifier PROD-700045. This payload should include all necessary attributes required to modify the existing product's design specifications.

200.description: Successful update of the product design.
